_about: Age x ethnicity/nationality figures for the age selector (schema harm-data/age-bands/v1). Built from official sources; values are never imputed or pro-rated. Category labels are kept as published.

fit_codes.exact: published band(s) add up exactly to the standard band
fit_codes.derived_exact: obtained exactly by adding/subtracting published cells (no assumptions)
fit_codes.computed_microdata: our tabulation of an official record-level file, exact ages
fit_codes.estimated: only an overlapping published band exists; the value shown is for approx_band, never pro-rated
fit_codes.unavailable: no published or computable figure for this band

race_notes: England and Wales court data use the 2011 Census 18+1 ethnicity categories, which separate White British, White Irish, Gypsy or Irish Traveller and Any other white background. Mixed groups such as White and Asian have partial European ancestry.
Homicide Index victim data use officer-identified ethnic appearance with broad groups only (White, Black, Asian, Mixed, Other).
Labels are kept exactly as published. Figures cover England and Wales only; no Scottish or Northern Irish table crossing age with ethnicity was found for this release, so they are not included.

series.title: Homicide victims by ethnic appearance and age, England and Wales, year ending March 2025
series.descriptor: Offences currently recorded as homicide, by age and ethnic appearance of victim (Home Office Homicide Index, ONS appendix Table 6a, all victims)
series.race_basis: Officer-identified ethnic appearance (ONS note 18); categories as published
series.no_rate_reason: ONS publishes rates by ethnic appearance only for all ages (3-year averages, Table 7), not by age.
series.native_note: ONS bands: Under 1, 1 to 4, 5 to 15, 16 to 24, 25 to 34, 35 to 44, 45 to 54, 55 to 64, 65 to 74, 75 plus. Totals may include victims of unknown age or sex (ONS note 17).
notes: Counts are homicide offences (one per victim) currently recorded as homicide, as at the Homicide Index data extraction for YE March 2025.
'White' in this source is a single officer-identified appearance category; it does not separate White British from other White groups.
Rates per million (all ages, Apr 2022 to Mar 2025 average): White 7.7, Black 36.8, Asian 10.6, Mixed 8.0, Other 9.9 (ONS Table 7b).
